source.boundary: A DU is a discardable primary item replaced directly in the system. The removed DU is discarded, not repaired. ItemReorder uses a DEPOT position.

predeclared_native_acceptance: All 21 populated source tables round-trip exactly; five guarded stages finish with exit zero, zero conversion errors, and only the expected ENLOG warning #108. The model, event log and report are nonempty and valid.
At least one critical aircraft failure identifies the installed DU. The system issues one local DU spare, performs inherited explicit 10-minute REMOVE and 20-minute REPLACE, and returns ready.
The removed failed DU physical individual is explicitly discarded at the base. No DU item direct-repair task or return-to-stock event occurs.

The base DU stock is replenished from depot stock through the configured two-hour route. A depot reorder of one new DU begins and completes after the configured one-hour lead. Physical identities and opening/terminal stock levels reconcile.

Native mission outcomes, 72 half-hour System/Stock report bins, failure and repair metrics, backorder, and terminal aircraft state agree with the event ledger. Raw and source hashes close, and a separate reviewer replays read-only acceptance.
limits: Only one seed, one primary DU, one base/depot pair, stock-based batch size one, and a 36-hour horizon are accepted if native evidence passes.
The secondary DP is covered by a separate accepted case; this run does not combine DU and DP in one system.
Other reorder policies, stations, seeds, GUI-only behavior and cross-engine equivalence remain unverified.
